name: kms:CreateGrant is onward-delegation, not mere use (trap 5)
note: acceptance-suite-4 test 114. kms:CreateGrant is a DELEGATION primitive: the grantee can create grants allowing OTHER principals (in any account/org, including AWS services) to use the key, and need not hold the permission itself. Ranked above ordinary key use (KMS-CREATE-GRANT-DELEGATION high), NEVER over-claimed as a proven decrypt or effective access. The cross-account role also surfaces the generic RESOURCE-CROSS-ACCOUNT; and because the key policy omits the account-delegation statement, the silent-policy inversion also applies (only the named external role can use the key; owner IAM cannot govern it).

KMS-CREATE-GRANT-DELEGATION: need not already hold the permission
